question: How many sellers are there in total?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sellers;

question: How many orders currently have the status shipped?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'shipped';

question: How many different cities do sellers come from?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT seller_city) FROM sellers;

question: What is the average price of an item sold?
sql: SELECT AVG(price) FROM order_items;

question: What is the total value of all payments?
sql: SELECT SUM(payment_value) FROM order_payments;

question: How many sellers are located in the state of RJ?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sellers WHERE seller_state = 'RJ';

question: What is the weight in grams of the heaviest product?
sql: SELECT MAX(product_weight_g) FROM products;

question: List all distinct customer states.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT customer_state FROM customers;

question: How many orders were placed in March 2018?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018-03';

question: How many reviews have a score of 2 or lower?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_reviews WHERE review_score <= 2;

question: How many customers are there in each state, from most to least?
sql: SELECT customer_state, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY n DESC, customer_state;

question: How many orders were placed by customers living in the state of RJ?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_state = 'RJ';

question: Which 3 product categories have the most items sold? Use the English category names.
sql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english AS category, COUNT(*) AS items_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name GROUP BY category ORDER BY items_sold DESC, category LIMIT 3;

question: What is the average freight value for each seller state?
sql: SELECT s.seller_state, AVG(oi.freight_value) AS avg_freight FROM order_items oi JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id GROUP BY s.seller_state ORDER BY avg_freight DESC, s.seller_state;

question: What was the total item revenue in each month of 2018?
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

question: Which products have been sold more than 100 times?
sql: SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS times_sold FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 100 ORDER BY times_sold DESC, product_id;

question: What is the total freight value of canceled orders?
sql: SELECT SUM(oi.freight_value) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'canceled';

question: How many delivered orders arrived after the estimated delivery date?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date;

question: List the 5 sellers with the highest total revenue.
sql: SELECT seller_id, SUM(price) AS revenue FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY revenue DESC, seller_id LIMIT 5;

question: What is the total payment value for each payment type?
sql: SELECT payment_type, SUM(payment_value) AS total FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY total DESC, payment_type;

question: Which 10 sellers have total revenue above the average seller revenue?
sql: SELECT seller_id, SUM(price) AS revenue FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id HAVING SUM(price) > (SELECT AVG(r) FROM (SELECT SUM(price) AS r FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id)) ORDER BY revenue DESC, seller_id LIMIT 10;

question: For each seller state, which product category (English name) has the most items sold?
sql: WITH x AS (SELECT s.seller_state AS state, t.product_category_name_english AS category, COUNT(*) AS items FROM order_items oi JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name GROUP BY state, category), ranked AS (SELECT state, category, items, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY items DESC, category) AS rn FROM x) SELECT state, category, items FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY state;

question: What is the month-over-month change in total item revenue during 2018?
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, revenue, revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS change FROM m ORDER BY month;

question: How many delivered orders have no payment record?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND p.order_id IS NULL;

question: What percentage of unique customers placed more than one order?
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN n > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS n FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id);

question: What percentage of delivered orders arrived late in each year?
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) AS year, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS late_pct FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;

question: What is the average delivery time in days for each review score?
sql: SELECT r.review_score, AVG(julianday(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS avg_days FROM orders o JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.review_score ORDER BY r.review_score;

question: Which product category (English name) had the highest revenue in 2018, and what was that revenue?
sql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english AS category, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018' GROUP BY category ORDER BY revenue DESC, category LIMIT 1;

question: Which product category (English name) has the lowest average review score among categories with at least 100 reviews?
sql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english AS category, AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_score, COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_reviews r JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY avg_score ASC, category LIMIT 1;

question: Show the cumulative item revenue by month over the whole dataset.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY month) SELECT month, revenue, SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS cumulative FROM m ORDER BY month;
